The concept has been discussed and debated in cultural criticism with regards to Western exceptionalism and which works constitute the canon, given the lack of official standardization of the category.


== Literary canon ==


=== Classic book ===

A classic is an artistic work that has been accoladed and culturally circulated as being exemplary in its medium because of its distinctions, and noteworthy in history as a result of its cultural associations. In the second-century Roman miscellany Attic Nights, Aulus Gellius refers to writers as "classicus... scriptor, non proletarius" ("A distinguished, not a commonplace writer"). Such classification were initiated with the Greeks' ranking their cultural works, with the word canon (ancient Greek κανών, kanṓn: "measuring rod, standard").
